limitations: Direct compatibility remains readable during the installed-project upgrade bridge, but new Direct admission is still rejected.

The capability is enforced in this source tree; target repositories must update their installed ACEF tools and hooks before they receive it.

Deterministic Stage 0 passed 6/6. The first real-world P0 pair completed without an eligible successful pair: legacy was product-complete but process-invalid, while candidate stopped fail-closed during Story 2 and was product-incomplete. This capability remains enforced, not proven or installed.

The first-pair repair adds bounded ATDD adjudication/correction, dependency-aware quarantine, typed-dispatch lifecycle measurement, and a frozen closeout actor inventory. Those mechanisms have deterministic coverage but no successful rerun yet.
